sents.zh: 中国北边有很大的草地。
sents.en: In the north of China there is a great grassland.

sents.zh: 那里没有山，只有天和草。
sents.en: There are no mountains there, only sky and grass.

sents.zh: 很久以前，那里住着一些人。
sents.en: Long ago some people lived there.

sents.zh: 他们每天骑马，走很远的路。
sents.en: They rode horses every day and travelled far.
Their horses were fast and fine.
They also made a writing of their own.

sents.zh: 他们和南边的宋朝做买卖。
sents.en: They traded with the Song in the south.
They sold horses and bought tea and cloth.

sents.zh: 他们在北方住了很多年。
sents.en: They lived in the north for many years.
